result:
Here's how I read it: members who've booked a lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets no texts from the club.

What I found in the booking app:

- **Nothing sends reminders yet.** The club already texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so sending a reminder text is straightforward.
- **23% of members have opted out of texts**, so under this spec they'd get no reminder at all. If no-shows are spread evenly, that's roughly a quarter of the problem left untouched.
- **Email is only a partial fallback.** It's blank for 61% of members, so many of the opted-out members probably can't be reached that way either.
- **A reminder alone doesn't free the lane.** For the waiting list to benefit, a member who can't come needs a quick way to cancel, such as a link in the reminder.

Let me know if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that most changes what gets built: what should opted-out members get?

- **Email the ones who have an email address, and send nothing to the rest.** This respects their choice and reaches some of them. It adds a little work, since we'd need an email template and sending set up. This is my pick.
- **Send them nothing,** as the spec says now. This is the simplest option, but that quarter of members stays unreminded.

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
